title: Convolutional Neural Network ensembles for accurate lung nodule malignancy prediction 2 years in the future

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Convolutional Neural Network ensembles for accurate lung nodule malignancy prediction 2 years in the future》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】The objective of this study was to use an ensemble of CNNs to predict which baseline nodules would be diagnosed as lung cancer in a second follow up screening after more than one year.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】The malignant nodules and nodule positive controls were divided into training and test cohorts.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
